nodes.label: Competitive gap analysis (H2/H3 verdicts, threats, window)
nodes.rationale: Synthesis of 15+ products: 8 unmet needs, hypothesis verdicts, threat model, and what Waypoint must not compete on.

nodes.label: Finding: H2 SUPPORTED (nobody does constraint-based adaptive route generation)
nodes.rationale: Across 15+ products: zero accept weather, crossings, or safety as routing constraints; zero connect routes to training state.

nodes.label: Finding: H3 SUPPORTED with monetization caveat (route wedge acquires, adaptive layer monetizes)
nodes.rationale: Plan wedge crowded and floored at free; route wedge open and demand-validated at three price points; basic generation anchored at zero by free web tools.

nodes.label: Threat: Strava+Runna plan-linked route generation (12 to 18 month window)
nodes.rationale: 50 to 60 percent likelihood of v1 within 18 months, 20 to 30 percent for full constraint depth. Early signals: Runna beta strings, routing-engineer postings, bundle marketing shifts.

edges.rationale: Defines the execution window: 12 to 18 months before a v1 exists.
